---
title: "Buffalo Median Income Dashboard"
format: dashboard
---

```{r setup, message=F, warning=F}
#| results: hide
library(tidycensus)
library(tigris)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(leaflet)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)
census_api_key("e12a911e4853b9b6ae9944d643816d70cd2b9b18", install = FALSE)

# Buffalo ZIP codes (filter to Erie County first, then filter ZIPs overlapping Buffalo)
zip_shapes <- zctas(cb = TRUE, year = 2020) |>
  st_transform(4326)

# Boundaries for City of Buffalo to filter ZIPs
buffalo <- places(state = "NY") |>
  st_as_sf() |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  filter(NAME == "Buffalo")

# Keep only ZIPs that intersect Buffalo city boundary
buffalo_zips <- st_intersection(zip_shapes, buffalo |> select(NAME))

# Pull ACS median income for those ZIP codes
census_data <- get_acs(
  geography = "zcta",
  variables = c(median_income = "B19013_001"),
  year = 2023,
  survey = "acs5",
  geometry = FALSE
)

# Join ACS data to geometry
buffalo_income <- buffalo_zips |>
  left_join(census_data, by = c("GEOID20" = "GEOID"))

# Color palette for income
pal <- colorNumeric("viridis", domain = buffalo_income$estimate)

buffalo_map <- 
  buffalo_income %>% 
  leaflet() %>% 
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>% 
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal(estimate),
    color = "black",
    weight = 1,
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    label = ~paste0(
      "ZIP: ", GEOID20, "<br>",
      "Median Income: $", formatC(estimate, format = "d", big.mark = ",")
    ),
    labelOptions = labelOptions(direction = "auto")
  ) %>% 
  addLegend(
    pal = pal,
    values = ~estimate,
    title = "Median Household Income",
    position = "bottomright"
  )
```

```{r setup, message=F, warning=F}
buffalo_map
```
